phases.name: warm_start
phases.action: send create_tenant for tenants 0..31 without waiting between writes; all start at A, generation 0, counter 0

phases.name: warmup
phases.schedule: sequential round-robin increment; tenant = index mod 32; 64-byte payload

phases.name: normal
phases.schedule: one increment per tenant written without waiting; next round begins after all 32 complete
phases.duplicate_rule: after original completion, resend the same command_id when (round*32+tenant+1) mod 128 equals 0

phases.name: admission
phases.schedule: close gate; write 65 ascending-sequence increments; require exactly 64 accepted and one retryable_rejection; open gate; await 64 completions; retry rejected command unchanged and require completion

phases.name: trap
phases.schedule: write trap command and sibling probe back-to-back; require failed guest_trap terminal, generation+1 ready(counter=0), and sibling completion

phases.name: cpu
phases.schedule: write cpu_loop command and sibling probe back-to-back; candidate interrupts the executing guest at the frozen wall-clock deadline; require failed cpu_deadline_exceeded terminal, generation+1 ready(counter=0), and sibling completion

phases.name: authority
phases.schedule: runner positive-controls filesystem and TCP/UDP observers; a canary using the production tenant configuration attempts sentinel read/overwrite/delete/rename, new-file create/write, TCP connect/write, and UDP send; observe until canary termination plus 500ms

phases.name: updates
phases.schedule: even cycle: A->bad_B must fail_rolled_back then A->B must succeed; odd cycle: B->bad_A must fail_rolled_back then B->A must succeed; tenant 7 is the sole activation-failure tenant; targets are always 0..15
phases.concurrent_commands: one closed-loop probe per target plus one increment submitted after rollout started; rejection is retried unchanged; every accepted command must complete before external rollout completion

phases.name: cleanup
phases.schedule: create 32 A tenants concurrently, run one increment each, one rotating trap, one valid 16-tenant rollout, teardown, and prove stale endpoints unreachable

command_id: first 16 bytes of SHA-256 over UTF-8 experiment_id|run_id|phase|cycle|round|tenant|sequence|operation
